title: THE CAPTAIN WHO RETURNED THE ENEMY'S DEAD
deck: Captain Rauk returns the commander who nearly destroyed his fleet but claims the navigation seed fused into the dead man's spine. With forty thousand people losing reactor heat, Illuminara must find a path to the living without making Commander Sen's body the war's last territory.
shape: Seven scenes across a six-hour ceasefire and one dawn: an armed seal, a daughter washing her father, an enemy captain admitted without guards, a failed reconstruction, voluntary evidence without surrender of the body, a mass-limited relief convoy and a burial that becomes the first rescue rule of an unfinished peace.

scenes.title: The Seal
paragraphs: *Damar mining habitat · Docking Ring Four · ceasefire hour zero*
Commander Eren Sen came home on an enemy ship, feet first, beneath a white cloth.
The trolley stopped between Damar and the Veyran corvette *Mercy of Ash*. Twelve guards faced twelve marines, rifles lowered.
Illuminara held golden force across the seal. No round could cross it. Six red lamps counted down the ceasefire.
Captain Ors Rauk kept one gloved hand on the trolley, thin from giving away portions before admitting famine.

**Rauk**  
We return Commander Sen to his family. His uniform, his marks and every wound are recorded. The navigation seed remains under Veyran claim.
Mara Sen stepped out from behind the Damar guards. She had her father's height and none of his uniform. Her hands were empty.

**Mara**  
The seed is fused to his spine.

**Rauk**  
Yes.

**Mara**  
Then you are claiming his spine.
Councilor Sela Arun spoke from beside the habitat's forensic surgeon.

**Sela**  
The seed crossed our perimeter in a hostile officer. It is evidence and a strategic device. Damar will receive it intact.
A Veyran finger tightened beside a trigger. A Damar rifle rose. Illuminara widened the field into a pause nobody could shoot through.

**Illuminara**  
Whose life depends on the seed before this ceasefire ends?
Rauk looked at the red lamps instead of her.

**Rauk**  
Forty thousand people wait beyond the Nacre Drift. Their reactor feed lasts eleven days.

**Sela**  
His fleet has besieged us for nine months.

**Rauk**  
We have not fired for three months and cannot leave. Sen found a passage. The seed contains it.
Mara reached for the trolley. Rauk did not release it.

**Mara**  
My father served this habitat until it used every hour he had. He is not serving one more shift for either of you.
At the threshold of hour one, the first red lamp went dark. Five hours remained.
Illuminara looked from the armed seal to the covered human shape.

**Illuminara**  
His daughter receives him first. Captain, witness that nothing is taken. Councilor, your surgeon may certify from outside. Weapons remain here.

**Sela**  
And the seed?

**Illuminara**  
Does not move. Neither does the war, for one hour.

scenes.title: The Quiet Room
paragraphs: *Damar memorial chamber · ceasefire hour one*
The room had no flags. Miners used it after pressure failures, where nationality mattered less than knowing whose hand to return.
Mara dismissed the attendants. Illuminara warmed water in a copper basin and waited until Mara nodded before drawing back the cloth.
Sen looked older than his victory portraits. Veyran surgeons had closed his chest wound carefully. Beneath the skin at his neck, the seed pulsed green.
Mara washed soot from her father's hair while Illuminara cleaned his hands. Questions waited until Mara began wrapping the burial cloth.

**Mara**  
He hated having his picture taken after a mission. He said the camera always made survival look like certainty.

**Illuminara**  
What did he think the seed was for?
Mara pulled the cloth too tightly, stopped and loosened it.

**Mara**  
It learned his choices: turn, burn, wait, trust a current. The navy said it could teach the next pilot. He said it could only teach them to mistake a dead man's luck for a road.
The seed was not a chart inside a body but a history of choices against changing forces. Extraction might yield a sequence, not a passage.
Illuminara felt its electrical rhythm but did not reach into it. A signal was not consent.

**Illuminara**  
Did he keep the external records?

**Mara**  
Damar has his telemetry, Veyrans have the wake, and prospectors mapped the Drift. No one has all three.

**Illuminara**  
Then no one has to own him to recover what he found.
Mara covered the green light with the final fold of cloth.

**Mara**  
Do not make hope another way to ask me for his body.

**Illuminara**  
I will ask you for a decision. I will not call refusal a failure of love.
They lifted Sen onto the bier and set his pilot's gloves over his chest. Only then did Illuminara ask whether Rauk could enter.

**Mara**  
No guards. No scanner. And he says my father's name before he says the word seed.

**Illuminara**  
Those are the terms.

scenes.title: The Same Dead Man
paragraphs: *Damar memorial chamber · ceasefire hour two*
Rauk entered without coat, weapon or rank. Illuminara's field held the seal: the armed delegations could shout but not cross.
Rauk stopped at the bier. For the first time since docking, his attention left the countdown.

**Rauk**  
Eren Sen.
Mara's jaw trembled once. She did not thank him.

**Mara**  
Did you kill him?

**Rauk**  
I ordered the pursuit. His ship broke under a shear after he turned from our fire. We recovered him alive. He died before our surgeon reached the bay.

**Mara**  
Why return him?

**Rauk**  
My mother vanished in retreat; every official sentence began with presumed. An enemy is not weather. I wanted one thing to arrive where it belonged.
He looked at the folded cloth over the seed.

**Rauk**  
But the route does not belong in a grave.
Mara moved between him and the bier.

**Mara**  
The route is not yours because you found the man who flew it.

**Rauk**  
You call the body sacred now that the map inside it can feed my children. When he carried it against us, you called that duty.
Mara hardened because part of it was true: Damar had praised Sen for carrying what it now called inviolable.
Sela's voice came through the ceiling speaker.

**Sela**  
Captain, your children are attached to warships.
Rauk turned toward the ceiling speaker.

**Rauk**  
They are attached to radiators. When reactors cool, the youngest die first. Does Damar's ethics change at a hull classification?
Illuminara opened a blank wall display with three columns.

**Illuminara**  
If we reconstruct it without touching Sen, will you disclose your ships' position and mass?

**Rauk**  
That would give Damar every target in my fleet.

**Illuminara**  
If we protect Damar's defenses, will you release Sen's telemetry to civilian navigators?

**Sela**  
That would show how our best pilot crossed the perimeter.

**Illuminara**  
Mara, if neither side takes the seed, will you permit a model of your father's last flight using records outside his body?
Mara looked at Rauk.

**Mara**  
Not until I know the model cannot become his second weapon.

**Illuminara**  
Then we test while each withholds what they fear losing. Failure will show which trust is load-bearing.

scenes.title: A Path Made of Absences
paragraphs: *Damar civilian survey bay · ceasefire hour three*

Surveyor Pei Lorn had mapped the Drift before war gave every stone a strategic name. Navigator Aven Tal joined her. Damar supplied stripped telemetry, Rauk withheld the fleet's origin, and Mara kept the key.
Pei built the first model from prospectors' gravity surveys, Sen's plasma wake and the Veyran pursuit's observed turns.
A narrow blue line appeared through the Drift. It survived for nine minutes, then crossed a shear that would tear a loaded barge in half.

**Pei**  
That is not a corridor. That is a very elegant funeral.

**Aven**  
Sen crossed it.

**Pei**  
Sen crossed something. Your observations lack an origin, and Damar's record has eleven blind seconds. We drew confidence across two missing facts.
Sela kept the blind interval classified; Rauk said his missing origin was still alive.
Illuminara tested the forces against a virtual relief barge. The shear wall caught its port tanks and spun it bright red.

**Illuminara**  
The seed would show Sen burning starboard, not whether he answered a hidden pulse, the pursuit angle or a current that has moved.
Mara studied the failed blue line.

**Mara**  
Can you make a route that feeds them and cannot carry an attack?
Pei expanded the barge parameters.

**Pei**  
Perhaps. If the line accepts only a cold convoy below fixed mass, an assault ship announces itself by dying.
Half the lamps were dark. Three hours remained. On the docking feed, guards accepted water through Illuminara's field without lowering rifles.

Illuminara made betrayal detectable: Pei and Aven would calculate separately, exchange signed predictions and test their overlap with unmanned canisters. Damar would reveal the blind interval without its cause; civilian beacons would hide firing geometry.

**Illuminara**  
You do not need one shared secret. You need predictions that meet in public reality.
For the first time, Mara almost smiled.

scenes.title: What the Living Give
paragraphs: *Damar memorial chamber and survey bay · ceasefire hour four*
The test needed three permissions. Mara returned to the quiet room; Rauk kept the distance she had set.
Rauk placed a dented metal ration cup beside the pilot's gloves.

**Rauk**  
Every child receives one. Now we collect them after meals so nobody hides tomorrow's portion for a younger brother. This is not innocence.

**Mara**  
Good. Because it is not.
He recorded his pursuit order and accepted an investigation into whether Sen could have been rescued sooner.
Mara put one hand over her father's covered wrist.

**Mara**  
You were right about one thing. He carried the seed by choice, and Damar called it duty because it helped us. But he said it could teach the navy to mistake a dead man's luck for a road. He chose while alive. None of us drafts him again.

**Rauk**  
Then I withdraw the Veyran claim to the seed. Not only the demand to extract it.

**Mara**  
I authorize an external model. No penetration, seed scan or copied signature. Publish its errors, including Damar's. Do not name the corridor after him.

**Rauk**  
Agreed.

**Mara**  
I am not doing this for you.

**Rauk**  
Neither were the people who kept my children alive last week. They still did it.

**Sela**  
If I reveal the eleven seconds, every Veyran navigator will know when our array cannot see.

**Illuminara**  
Reveal the pulse, not the array. Publish its effect on a cold barge. A warship carries too much magnetic mass and lights every sensor.

**Sela**  
And when the ceasefire ends?

**Illuminara**  
The beacons close. Another passage needs joint authorization. Humanitarian access is not a military right.
Sela looked toward the docking feed. She opened a channel.

**Sela**  
Send water across the seal. Both directions. Then release the pulse window to Pei Lorn under my key.
Aven supplied the origin and Pei the pulse. Two lines overlapped for fourteen kilometers.
The overlap accepted a slow convoy of six feed barges. It rejected every modeled corvette.

**Pei**  
There is your road. It is too narrow for victory.

scenes.title: The Cold Convoy
paragraphs: *Nacre Drift · ceasefire hour five*
One canister carried sensors and a child's ration cup; the other carried Damar ore dust.
Pei called Damar's vectors and Aven Veyran's. Illuminara shielded the canisters long enough to resolve disagreement, then withdrew before the critical turn so the route would not depend on her.
The canisters vanished behind a nickel body. Eleven seconds of telemetry silence followed.
At the seal, rifles rose when a Veyran alarm mistook blackout for attack. Illuminara's field brightened; Rauk opened command.

**Rauk**  
Veyran weapons cold. Any officer who paints Damar breaks my command and the ceasefire.
Sela answered on the public circuit.

**Sela**  
Damar batteries hold. Survey craft only.
The canisters reappeared intact and tightened the overlap.

**Pei**  
Send the ugly ships.
Six unarmed feed barges left with mixed survey crews. Signed route segments kept the whole corridor from every pilot.
Beside the bier, Mara heard Sen's engine pulses. At the seventh turn, Pei predicted port and Aven a pause.

**Aven**  
Sen paused. The pursuit record shows our lead ship overshooting him.

**Pei**  
A loaded barge that pauses there falls into the shear.
Mara closed her eyes.

**Mara**  
He was not loaded. He could wait for the current to lift him. The barges cannot.
An ore body had shifted since Sen's flight. A longer starboard burn traded fuel for clearance.

**Illuminara**  
Pei, test twelve seconds starboard at survey thrust.
The correction went out. Six barges burned starboard and emerged beyond the shear wall.
The ceasefire had twenty-three minutes left when the stranded fleet acknowledged the first barge. Reactor temperatures stopped falling.
Rauk lowered his head toward the quiet room.

**Rauk**  
Feed received. All Veyran ships remain beyond the beacon line.
Sela ordered rifles slung; Rauk did the same. The seal stayed open with no weapon pointed through it.
For the first time that day, Illuminara let the golden field disappear.

scenes.title: A Name, Not a Corridor
paragraphs: *Damar exterior memorial garden · the following dawn*
They buried Sen beneath a tree in the habitat's shallow soil. His spine was whole. Mara used the family key to silence the seed.
No Veyran uniform entered. Rauk stood beyond the transparent wall in a plain coat, visible but not invited.
Mara placed the pilot's gloves in the earth and kept the dented ration cup.

**Mara**  
I will send this back when the youngest child on your ship has eaten a full week.
Rauk touched two fingers to the glass.

**Rauk**  
I will send the meal records with it. Not as payment. As proof.
A Damar woman whose son died in Rauk's pursuit stopped beside Mara.

**Parent**  
Do not enter this garden. Send us the record, including the minutes between the shear and Sen's death in your bay.

**Rauk**  
I will. I will not ask the record to forgive me.
A Veyran message showed a child setting the cup beside a full bowl, then calling a younger brother to eat.
Later, Sela and Rauk signed one page: civilians controlled rescue beacons, both sides shared bounded predictions in mortal distress, and one crossing granted no permanent route.

**Sela**  
This does not settle the border.

**Rauk**  
It settles what we do when somebody is freezing beyond it.

**Pei**  
Publish the failed predictions too, or we learn only from luck.
Mara added the missing sentence: no body, living or dead, could be collateral for navigation.
Illuminara signed nothing. The rule did not need her name.
At sunrise, Damar's children brought lamps. Beyond the glass, a repaired Veyran radiator unfolded like a dark flower, warming people neither innocent nor dead.
Mara watched it open.

**Mara**  
He found a way through after all.

**Illuminara**  
You all did.
Mara shook her head.

**Mara**  
No. He found one crossing. We decided what it was for.
Under the new tree, there was a grave with a name. In the Drift, there was a corridor with none.

critic_line: Illuminara holds an armed seal long enough for a daughter to wash her father, and a captain who returned his enemy's dead gives up his claim on the body, so six unarmed barges cross a corridor that no warship can use and forty thousand people keep their heat.

shared_strengths: Strong premise, a ticking ceasefire clock and dialogue-driven negotiation with humane moral weight. Readers will finish and remember the body-as-collateral idea and the ration cup. The middle technical navigation section is dense and abstract, and the resolution is a little tidy, which limits enthusiasm.

Mara makes the conflict personal in one line, and the ceasefire gives readers a reason to keep turning pages. The navigation mechanics slow the middle, but the ending makes cooperation feel earned without asking anyone to forgive. The image of a named grave and an unnamed corridor is likely to stay with readers.
shared_reservations: Pei built the first model from prospectors' gravity surveys, Sen's plasma wake and the Veyran pursuit's observed turns.
Illuminara made betrayal detectable: Pei and Aven would calculate separately, exchange signed predictions and test their overlap with unmanned canisters.

translation_sl.title: KAPITAN, KI JE VRNIL SOVRAŽNIKOVEGA MRTVECA
translation_sl.deck: Kapitan Rauk vrne poveljnika, ki je skoraj uničil njegovo floto, vendar zahteva navigacijsko seme, zraščeno s hrbtenico mrtvega moža. Ker štirideset tisoč ljudi ostaja brez reaktorske toplote, mora Illuminara najti pot do živih, ne da bi telo poveljnika Sena postalo zadnje ozemlje vojne.
translation_sl.shape: Sedem prizorov v šesturnem premirju in eni zori: oboroženi pečat, hči, ki umiva očeta, sovražni kapitan, sprejet brez straže, neuspešna rekonstrukcija, prostovoljno ponujeni dokazi brez predaje telesa, reševalni konvoj z omejeno maso in pogreb, ki postane prvo reševalno pravilo nedokončanega miru.

scenes.title: Pečat
paragraphs: *Rudarski habitat Damar · Priklopni obroč štiri · ničta ura premirja*
Poveljnik Eren Sen se je vrnil domov na sovražni ladji, z nogami naprej, pod belo tkanino.
Voziček se je ustavil med Damarjem in veyransko korveto *Milost pepela*. Dvanajst stražarjev je stalo nasproti dvanajstim marincem, puške so bile spuščene.
Illuminara je čez pečat držala zlato silo. Skozenj ni mogel noben izstrelek. Šest rdečih luči je odštevalo premirje.
Kapitan Ors Rauk je eno orokavičeno roko držal na vozičku, suh, ker je razdajal svoje obroke, preden je priznal lakoto.

**Rauk**  
Poveljnika Sena vračamo njegovi družini. Njegova uniforma, znamenja in vsaka rana so zabeleženi. Navigacijsko seme ostaja predmet veyranske zahteve.
Mara Sen je stopila izza damarskih stražarjev. Bila je visoka kakor njen oče in brez vsega, kar je pomenila njegova uniforma. Njene roke so bile prazne.

**Mara**  
Seme je zraščeno z njegovo hrbtenico.

**Rauk**  
Da.

**Mara**  
Potem zahtevate njegovo hrbtenico.
Svetnica Sela Arun je spregovorila ob forenzičnem kirurgu habitata.

**Sela**  
Seme je v sovražnem častniku prečkalo naš obrambni obroč. Je dokaz in strateška naprava. Damar ga bo prejel nedotaknjenega.
Veyranski prst se je napel ob sprožilcu. Damarska puška se je dvignila. Illuminara je polje razširila v premor, skozi katerega nihče ni mogel streljati.

**Illuminara**  
Čigavo življenje je odvisno od semena, preden se to premirje konča?
Rauk je namesto vanjo pogledal rdeče luči.

**Rauk**  
Štirideset tisoč ljudi čaka onkraj Nacrejevega drifta. Njihova reaktorska zaloga bo zdržala enajst dni.

**Sela**  
Njegova flota nas oblega že devet mesecev.

**Rauk**  
Tri mesece nismo streljali in ne moremo oditi. Sen je našel prehod. Seme ga vsebuje.
Mara je segla po vozičku. Rauk ga ni izpustil.

**Mara**  
Moj oče je služil temu habitatu, dokler mu ni vzel vsake ure, ki jo je imel. Za nikogar od vaju ne bo oddelal niti ene izmene več.
Na pragu prve ure je prva rdeča luč ugasnila. Ostalo je pet ur.
Illuminara je pogledala od oboroženega pečata do pokrite človeške postave.

**Illuminara**  
Najprej ga prejme njegova hči. Kapitan, pričajte, da ni nič odvzeto. Svetnica, vaš kirurg lahko potrdi od zunaj. Orožje ostane tukaj.

**Sela**  
In seme?

**Illuminara**  
Ne premakne se. Tudi vojna se eno uro ne bo.

scenes.title: Tiha soba
paragraphs: *Spominska soba na Damarju · prva ura premirja*
V sobi ni bilo zastav. Rudarji so jo uporabljali po tlačnih nesrečah, kjer je narodnost pomenila manj kakor vedeti, čigavo roko je treba vrniti.
Mara je odslovila spremljevalce. Illuminara je segrela vodo v bakrenem umivalniku in počakala, da je Mara prikimala, preden je odgrnila tkanino.
Sen je bil videti starejši kakor na zmagovalnih portretih. Veyranski kirurgi so mu skrbno zaprli rano na prsih. Pod kožo na vratu je seme utripalo zeleno.
Mara je očetu spirala saje z las, Illuminara pa mu je očistila roke. Vprašanja so čakala, dokler Mara ni začela ovijati pogrebne tkanine.

**Mara**  
Sovražil je fotografiranje po misiji. Govoril je, da kamera preživetje vedno prikaže kakor gotovost.

**Illuminara**  
Čemu je bilo po njegovem mnenju namenjeno seme?
Mara je tkanino zategnila premočno, se ustavila in jo popustila.

**Mara**  
Učilo se je njegovih odločitev: obrni, pospeši, počakaj, zaupaj toku. Mornarica je govorila, da lahko nauči naslednjega pilota. On pa je govoril, da jih lahko nauči le zamenjati srečo mrtvega človeka za pot.
Seme ni bilo zemljevid v telesu, temveč zgodovina odločitev proti spreminjajočim se silam. Z izvlečenjem bi morda dobili zaporedje, ne prehoda.
Illuminara je zaznala njegov električni ritem, vendar ni posegla vanj. Signal ni bil soglasje.

**Illuminara**  
Je ohranil zunanje zapise?

**Mara**  
Damar ima njegovo telemetrijo, Veyrani imajo sled, prospektorji pa so kartirali Drift. Nihče nima vsega trojega.

**Illuminara**  
Potem si ga nikomur ni treba lastiti, da bi pridobili, kar je našel.
Mara je zeleno svetlobo pokrila z zadnjim pregibom tkanine.

**Mara**  
Naj upanje ne postane le še en način, kako me prosite za njegovo telo.

**Illuminara**  
Prosila vas bom za odločitev. Zavrnitve ne bom imenovala pomanjkanje ljubezni.
Sena sta dvignili na mrtvaški oder in mu na prsi položili pilotske rokavice. Šele potem je Illuminara vprašala, ali sme Rauk vstopiti.

**Mara**  
Brez straže. Brez skenerja. In izreče ime mojega očeta, preden izgovori besedo seme.

**Illuminara**  
To so pogoji.

scenes.title: Isti mrtvi človek
paragraphs: *Spominska soba na Damarju · druga ura premirja*
Rauk je vstopil brez plašča, orožja ali čina. Illuminara je s poljem držala pečat: oboroženi delegaciji sta lahko kričali, ne pa ga prečkali.
Rauk se je ustavil ob mrtvaškem odru. Prvič po priklopu se njegova pozornost ni več držala odštevanja.

**Rauk**  
Eren Sen.
Marina čeljust je enkrat vztrepetala. Ni se mu zahvalila.

**Mara**  
Ste ga ubili?

**Rauk**  
Ukazal sem zasledovanje. Njegova ladja se je zlomila v strigu, potem ko se je umaknil našemu ognju. Rešili smo ga živega. Umrl je, preden je naš kirurg dosegel oddelek.

**Mara**  
Zakaj ste ga vrnili?

**Rauk**  
Moja mati je izginila med umikom; vsak uradni stavek se je začel z domnevno. Sovražnik ni vreme. Hotel sem, da vsaj nekaj prispe tja, kamor spada.
Pogledal je prepognjeno tkanino nad semenom.

**Rauk**  
Toda pot ne spada v grob.
Mara je stopila med njega in mrtvaški oder.

**Mara**  
Pot ni vaša zato, ker ste našli človeka, ki jo je preletel.

**Rauk**  
Telo imenujete sveto zdaj, ko lahko zemljevid v njem nahrani moje otroke. Ko ga je nosil proti nam, ste temu rekli dolžnost.
Mara je otrpnila, ker je bilo del tega res: Damar je Sena slavil, ker je nosil nekaj, kar je zdaj imenoval nedotakljivo.
Selin glas se je oglasil iz stropnega zvočnika.

**Sela**  
Kapitan, vaši otroci so priključeni na bojne ladje.
Rauk se je obrnil proti stropnemu zvočniku.

**Rauk**  
Priključeni so na radiatorje. Ko se reaktorji ohladijo, najmlajši umrejo prvi. Se Damarjeva etika spremeni ob klasifikaciji trupa?
Illuminara je odprla prazen stenski zaslon s tremi stolpci.

**Illuminara**  
Če pot rekonstruiramo, ne da bi se dotaknili Sena, boste razkrili položaj in maso svojih ladij?

**Rauk**  
S tem bi Damarju dal vsako tarčo v svoji floti.

**Illuminara**  
Če zaščitimo Damarjevo obrambo, boste Senovo telemetrijo predali civilnim navigatorjem?

**Sela**  
To bi pokazalo, kako je naš najboljši pilot prečkal obrambni obroč.

**Illuminara**  
Mara, če nobena stran ne vzame semena, boste dovolili model zadnjega poleta svojega očeta iz zapisov zunaj njegovega telesa?
Mara je pogledala Rauka.

**Mara**  
Ne, dokler ne vem, da model ne more postati njegovo drugo orožje.

**Illuminara**  
Potem bomo preizkušali, medtem ko vsak zadrži tisto, česar se boji izgubiti. Neuspeh bo pokazal, katero zaupanje je nosilno.

scenes.title: Pot iz odsotnosti
paragraphs: *Civilni merilni oddelek na Damarju · tretja ura premirja*

Merilka Pei Lorn je kartirala Drift, še preden je vojna vsakemu kamnu dala strateško ime. Pridružila se ji je navigatorka Aven Tal. Damar je predal očiščeno telemetrijo, Rauk je prikril izhodišče flote, Mara pa je obdržala ključ.
Pei je prvi model sestavila iz prospektorskih gravitacijskih meritev, Senove plazemske sledi in opazovanih obratov veyranskega zasledovanja.
Skozi Drift se je prikazala ozka modra črta. Zdržala je devet minut, nato pa prečkala strig, ki bi natovorjeno barko raztrgal na pol.

**Pei**  
To ni koridor. To je zelo eleganten pogreb.

**Aven**  
Sen ga je prečkal.

**Pei**  
Sen je prečkal nekaj. Vašim opazovanjem manjka izhodišče, Damarjev zapis pa ima enajst slepih sekund. Čez dve manjkajoči dejstvi smo narisali gotovost.
Sela je slepi interval ohranila tajen; Rauk je dejal, da je njegovo manjkajoče izhodišče še živo.
Illuminara je sile preizkusila na virtualni reševalni barki. Stena striga je zagrabila njene leve tanke in jo obarvala živo rdeče.

**Illuminara**  
Seme bi pokazalo, da je Sen pospešil desno, ne pa, ali se je odzval na skriti pulz, na kot zasledovanja ali na tok, ki se je premaknil.
Mara je preučevala spodletelo modro črto.

**Mara**  
Lahko naredite pot, ki jih bo nahranila in po kateri ni mogoče napasti?
Pei je razširila parametre barke.

**Pei**  
Morda. Če črta sprejme samo hladen konvoj pod določeno maso, se napadalna ladja razkrije tako, da umre.
Polovica luči je bila temna. Ostale so tri ure. Na priklopnem prenosu so stražarji skozi Illuminarino polje sprejeli vodo, ne da bi spustili puške.

Illuminara je omogočila, da bi bila izdaja zaznavna: Pei in Aven bi računali ločeno, si izmenjali podpisane napovedi in njuno prekrivanje preizkusili z brezpilotnimi vsebniki. Damar bi razkril slepi interval brez vzroka; civilni svetilniki bi skrili geometrijo streljanja.

**Illuminara**  
Ne potrebujete ene skupne skrivnosti. Potrebujete napovedi, ki se srečajo v javni resničnosti.
Mara se je prvič skoraj nasmehnila.

scenes.title: Kar dajo živi
paragraphs: *Spominska soba in merilni oddelek na Damarju · četrta ura premirja*
Za preizkus so potrebovali tri dovoljenja. Mara se je vrnila v tiho sobo; Rauk je ohranil razdaljo, ki jo je določila.
Rauk je ob pilotske rokavice položil obtolčeno kovinsko skodelico za obrok.

**Rauk**  
Vsak otrok dobi eno. Zdaj jih po obrokih pobiramo, da nihče ne skrije jutrišnjega deleža za mlajšega brata. To ni nedolžnost.

**Mara**  
Dobro. Ker ni.
Posnel je svoj ukaz za zasledovanje in sprejel preiskavo, ali bi Sena lahko rešili prej.
Mara je položila roko čez očetovo pokrito zapestje.

**Mara**  
Glede nečesa ste imeli prav. Seme je nosil po lastni izbiri, Damar pa je temu rekel dolžnost, ker nam je koristilo. Toda dejal je, da lahko mornarico nauči zamenjati srečo mrtvega človeka za pot. Odločil se je, ko je bil živ. Nihče od nas ga ne bo znova vpoklical.

**Rauk**  
Potem umikam veyransko zahtevo po semenu. Ne le zahteve, da ga izvlečemo.

**Mara**  
Dovoljujem zunanji model. Brez preboja, skeniranja semena ali kopiranja podpisa. Objavite njegove napake, tudi Damarjeve. Koridorja ne poimenujte po njem.

**Rauk**  
Dogovorjeno.

**Mara**  
Tega ne počnem za vas.

**Rauk**  
Tudi ljudje, ki so prejšnji teden ohranili moje otroke pri življenju, tega niso počeli zame. Pa so vseeno storili.

**Sela**  
Če razkrijem enajst sekund, bo vsak veyranski navigator vedel, kdaj naš niz ne vidi.

**Illuminara**  
Razkrijte pulz, ne niza. Objavite njegov učinek na hladno barko. Bojna ladja nosi preveč magnetne mase in prižge vsak senzor.

**Sela**  
In ko se premirje konča?

**Illuminara**  
Svetilniki se zaprejo. Drug prehod zahteva skupno odobritev. Humanitarni dostop ni vojaška pravica.
Sela je pogledala proti priklopnemu prenosu. Odprla je kanal.

**Sela**  
Pošljite vodo čez pečat. V obe smeri. Nato pod mojim ključem posredujte časovno okno pulza Pei Lorn.
Aven je prispevala izhodišče, Pei pa pulz. Dve črti sta se prekrivali štirinajst kilometrov.
Prekrivanje je sprejelo počasen konvoj šestih oskrbovalnih bark. Zavrnilo je vsako modelirano korveto.

**Pei**  
Tu je vaša pot. Preozka je za zmago.

scenes.title: Hladni konvoj
paragraphs: *Nacrejev drift · peta ura premirja*
En vsebnik je nosil senzorje in otroško skodelico za obrok; drugi je nosil damarski rudniški prah.

Pei je narekovala Damarjeve vektorje, Aven pa veyranske. Illuminara je vsebnika ščitila dovolj dolgo, da so razrešili nesoglasje, nato pa se je pred kritičnim obratom umaknila, da pot ne bi bila odvisna od nje.
Vsebnika sta izginila za nikljevim telesom. Sledilo je enajst sekund telemetrijske tišine.
Ob pečatu so se puške dvignile, ko je veyranski alarm zamenjal izpad za napad. Illuminarino polje je zasijalo močneje; Rauk je odprl poveljniški kanal.

**Rauk**  
Veyransko orožje naj ostane hladno. Vsak častnik, ki nameri v Damar, krši moje povelje in premirje.
Sela je odgovorila po javnem kanalu.

**Sela**  
Damarjeve baterije ne streljajo. Samo merilna plovila.
Vsebnika sta se prikazala nepoškodovana in zožila prekrivanje.

**Pei**  
Pošljite grde ladje.
Šest neoboroženih oskrbovalnih bark je odplulo z mešanimi merilnimi posadkami. Podpisani odseki poti so preprečili, da bi kateri koli pilot poznal ves koridor.
Ob mrtvaškem odru je Mara poslušala pulze Senovih motorjev. Pri sedmem obratu je Pei napovedala levo, Aven pa premor.

**Aven**  
Sen je počakal. Zapis zasledovanja kaže, da ga je naša vodilna ladja prehitela.

**Pei**  
Natovorjena barka, ki tam počaka, pade v strig.
Mara je zaprla oči.

**Mara**  
Ni bil natovorjen. Lahko je počakal, da ga tok dvigne. Barke ne morejo.
Rudno telo se je od Senovega poleta premaknilo. Daljši pospešek desno je zamenjal gorivo za varno razdaljo.

**Illuminara**  
Pei, preizkusite dvanajst sekund desno z merilnim potiskom.
Popravek je šel na pot. Šest bark je pospešilo desno in izplulo onkraj stene striga.
Do konca premirja je ostalo triindvajset minut, ko je obtičala flota potrdila prvo barko. Reaktorske temperature so nehale padati.
Rauk je sklonil glavo proti tihi sobi.

**Rauk**  
Oskrba prejeta. Vse veyranske ladje ostajajo za črto svetilnikov.
Sela je ukazala, naj puške obesijo prek ramen; Rauk je storil enako. Pečat je ostal odprt brez orožja, usmerjenega skozenj.
Illuminara je prvič tistega dne dovolila, da je zlato polje izginilo.

scenes.title: Ime, ne koridor
paragraphs: *Zunanji spominski vrt na Damarju · naslednja zora*
Sena so pokopali pod drevesom v plitvi prsti habitata. Njegova hrbtenica je bila cela. Mara je z družinskim ključem utišala seme.
Nobena veyranska uniforma ni vstopila. Rauk je v navadnem plašču stal za prosojno steno, viden, vendar nepovabljen.
Mara je položila pilotske rokavice v zemljo, obtolčeno skodelico za obrok pa obdržala.

**Mara**  
Vrnem jo, ko bo najmlajši otrok na vaši ladji ves teden jedel do sitega.
Rauk se je z dvema prstoma dotaknil stekla.

**Rauk**  
Z njo bom poslal zapise o obrokih. Ne kot plačilo. Kot dokaz.
Ob Mari se je ustavila Damarčanka, katere sin je umrl med Raukovim zasledovanjem.

**Starš**  
Ne vstopajte v ta vrt. Pošljite nam zapis, tudi minute med strigom in Senovo smrtjo v vašem oddelku.

**Rauk**  
Bom. Od zapisa ne bom prosil, naj mi odpusti.
Veyransko sporočilo je pokazalo otroka, ki je postavil skodelico ob polno skledo, nato pa poklical mlajšega brata k jedi.
Pozneje sta Sela in Rauk podpisala eno stran: civilisti so nadzorovali reševalne svetilnike, obe strani sta v smrtni nevarnosti delili omejene napovedi, en prehod pa ni dajal trajne poti.

**Sela**  
To ne reši meje.

**Rauk**  
Reši, kaj storimo, ko nekdo onkraj nje zmrzuje.

**Pei**  
Objavite tudi spodletele napovedi, sicer se učimo samo iz sreče.
Mara je dodala manjkajoči stavek: nobeno telo, živo ali mrtvo, ne sme biti stranska škoda navigacije.
Illuminara ni podpisala ničesar. Pravilo ni potrebovalo njenega imena.
Ob sončnem vzhodu so Damarjevi otroci prinesli svetilke. Za steklom se je popravljeni veyranski radiator razprl kakor temen cvet in grel ljudi, ki niso bili ne nedolžni ne mrtvi.
Mara ga je gledala, kako se odpira.

**Mara**  
Navsezadnje je našel pot skozi.

**Illuminara**  
Vsi ste jo našli.
Mara je zmajala z glavo.

**Mara**  
Ne. On je našel en prehod. Mi smo se odločili, čemu služi.
Pod novim drevesom je bil grob z imenom. V Driftu je bil koridor brez njega.

translation_sl.critic_line: Illuminara dovolj dolgo zadrži oboroženi pečat, da lahko hči umije svojega očeta, kapitan, ki je vrnil sovražnikovega mrtveca, pa se odpove svoji zahtevi po telesu; zato šest neoboroženih bark prečka koridor, ki ga ne more uporabiti nobena bojna ladja, in štirideset tisoč ljudi ohrani toploto.
